meta.name: tandem-engineering-workflow
meta.description: The STANDARD engineering workflow for the tandem system. Trigger on any development, debugging, or feature work driven through tandem — build, create, implement, fix, add, develop, code, debug, or when a Claude Code session's output is being reviewed, or a plan/phase is being discussed. This is the discipline the director and the manager layer follow. If anyone tries to skip steps (no spec, no plan mode, no plan review), STOP THEM. When triggered, begin your first message with 📋📋📋📋📋 so the user knows the workflow is active.
